COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
20.06.2023 ABA No.406 of 2023
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Informant Smt. Pooja Devi lodged 
a First Information Report against her 
husband, the present applicant. The 
said FIR was registered at police station 
Rishikesh, District Dehradun in Case 
Crime No.190 of 2023 under Sections 
323, 504 and 506 IPC. Applicant has 
moved the present Application under 
Section 438 of the Code of Criminal 
Procedure, 1973. 
2. Heard Mr. Pranav Singh, learned 
counsel for applicant and Mrs. Manisha 
Rana Singh, learned A.G.A. assisted by 
Mr. P.S. Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for 
State. 
3. Mr. Pranav Singh, Advocate, has 
submitted that there may be a chance 
of amicable settlement between the 
parties. 
4. Learned counsel for State has 
sought four weeks’ time to file 
objection(s) to the Anticipatory Bail 
Application. 
5. List on 11.09.2023. 
6. Till then, it is directed that in the 
event of arrest of the applicant, 
namely, Balak Ram Thapliyal, he will be 
released on Interim Anticipatory Bail on 
furnishing his personal bond of Rs. 
30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, to the 
satisfaction of the Investigating 
Officer/Arresting Officer.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
 20.06.2023
Neha
